mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < 0% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) fall simultaneously, it indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates growing consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) both show a decline, it indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances.
